name: 22551 · Spotsylvania, VA
findings: ZIP 22551 (Spotsylvania) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22551 (Spotsylvania) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
